notes: TWO folded thicknesses are published, split by back material (not hinge/non-hinge side): 9.85 mm (Vegan Fiber) and 9.9 mm (Vegan Leather). Per the larger-value rule 9.9 is recorded in closed.depth and both are quoted; no hinge-side value is published, so depth_at_hinge is null. Mass is a single published value (239 g) covering both finishes. Huawei explicitly states what the thickness excludes: "Folded thickness does not include the appearance of the camera module. Unfolded thickness does not include screen borders." - so closed.depth 9.9 mm is a body thickness WITHOUT the camera bump, which matters for a CAD envelope. Height 156.6 mm is published as one value for both states. The China spec page independently confirms every figure: "长度 156.6 mm 宽度 折叠：73.78 mm 展开：144.04 mm 厚度 折叠：9.85 mm（锦纤版）/ 9.9 mm（素皮版）展开：4.6 mm 重量 约 239 克" = "Length 156.6 mm; Width folded 73.78 mm, unfolded 144.04 mm; Thickness folded 9.85 mm (fibre version) / 9.9 mm (vegan-leather version), unfolded 4.6 mm; Weight approx. 239 g". Chinese translations of the cited hinge/glass lines: "全新玄武水滴铰链，体积小巧，开合流畅，悬停稳当。采用 1900 MPa 创新火箭钢材料" = "All-new Basalt water-drop hinge - compact, smooth to open and close, stable when hovering. It uses an innovative 1900 MPa rocket-steel material." "悬停拍照，悬停稳当，解放双手" = "Hover photography - stable hovering, hands free." "玻璃类型 ... 第二代昆仑玻璃 ... 典藏版：第二代玄武钢化昆仑玻璃" = "Glass type: HUAWEI Mate X6 - 2nd-generation Kunlun Glass; Collector's Edition - 2nd-generation Basalt-tempered Kunlun Glass." The teardrop crease and free-stop hovering are stated on Huawei's China page only; the English page calls it only an "Advanced precision hinge ... Made of 1900 MPa ultra-high strength steel". The China page lists a wider colour/material split than the English one; materials.back records the English-page wording. Display aspect ratios are not published - left null; PPI is published (Main 417, Cover 413) but active_area_mm is left null because Huawei states the diagonals are standard-rectangle measurements with a slightly smaller actual viewing area. resolution_px recorded in Huawei's printed order (long axis first). announced/released null: no manufacturer page carrying a launch date for this model was found; the November/December 2024 dates appear only on excluded secondary sources. || EVIDENCE SWEEP 2026-09-13: these values were present in the research pass but carried NO sources[] entry covering their field, so they were set to null per the registry rule (a value without a citation is an assertion, not evidence).
